items.briefing:
A recent study highlights that AI-related security incidents are costing large organisations millions of dollars, a timely reminder for Australian RTOs exploring AI tools to ensure proper oversight and controls are in place. Separately, a security flaw in a default Microsoft Azure Automation setting has been identified that could allow attackers to compromise accounts across different tenants — organisations using Azure cloud services should check with their IT provider that this has been addressed.

Scam activity continues to be a concern for Australians, with Scamwatch flagging ongoing alerts. **Practical tip:** If your organisation uses Microsoft Azure, ask your IT team or provider to review your Azure Automation account settings and disable any unnecessary default permissions.
